Workspace stop kinds (`specs/workspace-stop-kinds.md`): migration 042 adds `pool_hosts.stop_kind`, stamped by every stop (`owner` by the owner route, `suspension` by the suspend fan-out, and the kind named in the operator stop's new body, `maintenance` / `idle` / `suspension`, defaulting to `idle`) and cleared by every start. The operator stop re-stamps the kind on a row that is already stopping or stopped. The owner's start refuses `maintenance` and `suspension` rows from `stopping` onwards with `409 workspace_under_maintenance` ("This machine is undergoing maintenance and will be back shortly."), which is also what the cutover's parked-row guard now answers (the `workspace_migrating` code is gone), and the owner start's CAS carries the same hold predicate, so a hold stamped between the route's read and its CAS is refused rather than cleared; the operator start ignores the kind. `GET /workspaces` carries `stop_kind`, a new admin route `POST /admin/workspaces/{id}/stop-kind` changes a stopped row's kind, and the unsuspend fan-out rewrites the account's `suspension` stops to `idle` so the user can start them. Motivated by the 2026-09-13 staging drill in which a desktop's unattended recovery restarted a workspace between the migrate's stop and its park.
